metadata.name: compartment.recordKey
metadata.description: (tbl, rowId) — the stable string key foldRecords uses to identify a record.

metadata.name: compartment.foldRecords
metadata.description: (cells) — LWW fold of decrypted cell-writes: highest-hlc write wins per (tbl,rowId,col), merging across resource-versions; returns records.

metadata.name: compartment.recordResources
metadata.description: (tags, tbl, rowId) — the sorted set of resources a record is tagged to in the index.

metadata.name: compartment.visibleRecords
metadata.description: (tags, held) — records visible to a holder of `held` resources: those tagged to at least one held resource.

metadata.name: compartment.canConsolidate
metadata.description: (tags, held) — true iff every tagged resource is held; the gate that lets a locker consolidate only what it can decrypt.

metadata.name: compartment.resourcesOf
metadata.description: (tags) — the distinct resources referenced by a tag set.
